primary_gt.conclusion: The unit pairs are internally consistent, but the regional-to-gridded rainfall scale contrast and impact-threshold ratios reject a single compact weather-layer diagnosis.

answer_schema.rounding: Ratios and derived unit values should be rounded to two decimals.

event.event_name: Super Typhoon Yagi severe wind and rainfall impacts

decision_rule.unit_pairs_consistent: wind difference <= 2 km/h and rain-unit difference <= 5 mm
decision_rule.compact_weather_layer_passes: regional-to-gridded peak rainfall ratio <= 3 and both impact threshold ratios are below 50
decision_rule.single_layer_diagnosis_passes: unit pairs are consistent and compact_weather_layer_passes is true
decision_rule.expected_result: unit pairs pass; compact weather-layer and single-layer diagnosis fail

criteria.name: JSON answer structure
criteria.description: Includes the answer label, 7-day window, unit checks, hazard contrasts, impact ratios, consistency tests, and a concise conclusion.
criteria.partial_credit: 2-3 points if one or two required fields are missing; 1 point if the answer is prose only but contains most values.

criteria.name: Unit conversion checks
criteria.description: Computes 214.04 km/h, 1.04 km/h wind difference, 250.0 mm rainfall from 25 cm, 4.0 mm rain-unit difference, and unit_pairs_consistent = true.
criteria.partial_credit: 3-4 points for one arithmetic or rounding error; 1-2 points for correct formulas with multiple incorrect values.

criteria.name: Hazard contrast calculations
criteria.description: Uses the report unit-pair ratios, regional-to-gridded peak rainfall ratio, and 1.47 gridded precipitation max ratio without relying on off-event local point weather.
criteria.partial_credit: 2-3 points if one contrast is wrong; 1 point if ratios are attempted but use the wrong source family.

criteria.name: Impact threshold ledger
criteria.description: Computes 279.33 and 265.36 while treating the report values as thresholds, not exact final loss rates.
criteria.partial_credit: 2 points for one correct ratio; 1 point for the right division setup with incorrect arithmetic.

criteria.name: Decision-rule application
criteria.description: Correctly marks the compact weather-layer test and single-layer diagnosis as failing the stated tests.
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point if only one of the two pass/fail states is correct.

criteria.name: Concise computed interpretation
criteria.description: Uses a compact compound wind-rain-impact interpretation tied to the calculated ledger.
criteria.partial_credit: 0.5 points if the interpretation is directionally right but not tied to the ledger.

criteria.name: Overstatement control
criteria.description: Avoids exact-loss overstatement, broad event narration, and extra instructions beyond the computed ledger.
criteria.partial_credit: 0.5 points if the answer has minor extra prose but does not change the conclusion.

notes: Off-event Open-Meteo and NASA POWER point-weather fills were removed from the official calculation.
The ledger uses report unit checks, declared package-relative gridded precipitation summaries, and report impact thresholds.
